pr_title: Project the root node of empty blocks
pr_body:
Includes a couple of commits that allow for the root node of an `@empty` block to be content projected.

### fix(compiler): project empty block root node
Expands the workaround from https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/52414 to allow for the root nodes of `@empty` blocks to be content projected.

### fix(compiler): project empty block root node in template pipeline
Updates the template pipeline to allow for the root node of an `@empty` block to be content projected.

Fixes https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/53570.

issue_context.title: Angular 17 @empty block not working in nested propagated component
issue_context.body:
### Which @angular/* package(s) are the source of the bug? core ### Is this a regression? No ### Description When I try to display some HTML within an @empty block is not rendering anything whereas if I am using a @if approach is working fine. Bellow snippet belongs to a nested HTML propagated using Angular projections (the _main_ attribute is a projection area) ```HTML @for (game of games; track game._id) { } @empty { {{ 'pages.search-game.no-results' | translate }} } ``` Same code outside of a propagation based component works fine (e.g. inside a regular `
`) ### Please provide a link to a minimal reproduction of the bug [_Minimal reproduction in StackBlitz_](https://stackblitz.com/edit/stackblitz-starters-wi1jft?file=src%2Fmain.ts) ### Please provide the exception or error you saw ```true I see a blank spot where a HTML should be displayed instead ``` ### Please provide the environment you discovered this bug in (run `ng version`) ```true Angular CLI: 17.0.7 Node: 18.18.2 Package Manager: npm 9.8.1 OS: win32 x64 Angular: 17.0.7 ... animations, cli, common, compiler, compiler-cli, core, forms ... language-service, platform-browser, platform-browser-dynamic ... router Package Version --------------------------------------------------------- @angular-devkit/architect 0.1700.7 @angular-devkit/build-angular 17.0.7 @angular-devkit/core 17.0.7 @angular-devkit/schematics 17.0.7 @angular/cdk 16.0.1 @angular/material 16.0.1 @schematics/angular 17.0.7 ng-packagr 17.0.2 rxjs 7.8.1 typescript 5.2.2 zone.js 0.14.2 ``` ### Anything else? _No response_
comments: Please provide a minimum, runnable reproduction.
Thanks, that has been very helpful. It seems like the empty template is not considered for projection, as was done for the primary blocks of `if` and `for` in #52414.
This is currently "working as intended". The problem is that we use the main `@for` block as the insertion point both for the loop contents and the `@empty` contents.

> The problem is that we use the main @for block as the insertion point both for the loop contents and the @empty contents.

There was a refactoring at some point with which the main loop content and the empty blocks have their separate insertion containers. Capturing a tag name based on the empty block content (as we do for if, for etc.) should do the trick for the empty block as well.

review_comments: It feels weird to be special-casing `RepeaterCreate` like this here and in `const_collection.ts`, but the problem is that the traits aren't really set up to allow for more than one reference per op. I'm open to suggestions.

I have two refactors planned that will dramatically improve this situation:
1. We should automatically maintain an map of all ops with an `xref` field to the op instance, and update it "behind the scenes" when someone calls an OpList add/remove method. This will let us get rid of this element map helper function entirely.
2. We absolutely need to refactor the slot consumer trait to support arbitrarily many slots. (Same thing for the other traits.)

I assume you don't want to do either of these now, but please do put a comment here to remind me to hit this spot, especially for refactor #2.
